en.askTitle: Enter your own rides, budget and bike offer to test whether a delivery PAB pays back
en.runTitle: Woodlands, Singapore: a PR delivering 35 hours a week weighs a power-assisted bicycle on SGD 1,500

fields.label: Platform and status
fields.value: Singapore PR, aged 42, delivering food on a regular bicycle from Woodlands

fields.label: Routes and longest shift distance
fields.placeholder: e.g. Woodlands to Yishun, longest shift about 60 km

fields.label: Exact model and battery offer
fields.placeholder: e.g. a S$1,299 model with a 48V 10Ah battery

fields.label: Charging and storage setup
fields.placeholder: e.g. charge indoors at home, bike kept inside the flat

fields.label: Online hours, payouts, expenses and CPF status
fields.value: About 35 hours a week on delivery

en.template: Help me compare a delivery PAB with keeping my bicycle. My platform and status are {platform}, routes and longest shift distance {routes}, all-in budget {budget}, exact model/battery offer {model}, and charging/storage setup {charging}. Check approval, equipment and insurance gaps, then stress-test payback using my {earnings}. Ask before contacting anyone, sharing documents, buying or applying.

phases.title: Read the current rules, platform insurance and earnings evidence, and find real bike listings
phases.note: LTA rules and approved list, platform rider pages, insurance, CPF, five retailer listings
phases.judgment: It would not invent an earnings gain. The only earnings sources it found, a 2022 research paper and a dated 2026 Grab sign-up offer, do not show a lasting pay uplift from a power-assisted bike, and a platform insurance page it could only see as a search snippet was marked unconfirmed.

phases.title: Write the guide with the budget and payback calculations
phases.note: Recommendation first, rules checklist, five models, insurance comparison, payback table

phases.title: Independent check of claims and arithmetic, plus desktop and phone layout
Fill the gaps the check found: riding conduct rules and penalties
phases.judgment: The independent check found the rules checklist was missing things a rider needs: riding single file, bicycle lanes and what to do after an accident on a path. It added them with four penalty examples taken from LTA, and the check then confirmed each example matches the source table.

phases.title: Re-run the arithmetic, consistency and layout checks
Update the independent check with what is resolved and what remains open
phases.note: Open items stay listed: exact-unit approval, insurance, accessory costs

workers: Read the delivery platforms’ own rider rules and insurance pages, the CPF position for a PR, and dated public earnings evidence
Found five retailer-listed power-assisted bicycles with dated prices and battery range, and checked them against the official LTA approved list
Independently recomputed every money figure and checked the guide against its sources; flagged missing riding rules, then rechecked after the fix

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的路线、预算和车款报价，就能测试送餐用助力自行车值不值得买
zh.runTitle: 新加坡兀兰：一位永久居民每周送餐 35 小时，在 1,500 新元预算内考虑换助力自行车

fields.label: 我的平台及身份
fields.value: 新加坡永久居民，42 岁，在兀兰骑普通自行车送餐

fields.label: 路线及最长班次里程
fields.placeholder: 例如：兀兰到义顺，最长一班约 60 公里

fields.label: 具体车型及电池报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：售价 1,299 新元、48V 10Ah 电池的车型

fields.label: 家中充电收纳条件
fields.placeholder: 例如：在家里室内充电，车放在屋内

fields.label: 上线工时、收入、费用及 CPF 状态

zh.template: 帮我比较购买送餐 PAB 和保留自行车。我的平台及身份是 {platform}，路线及最长班次里程是 {routes}，全部预算 {budget}，具体车型及电池报价 {model}，家中充电收纳条件 {charging}。先检查批准、装备和保险缺口，再按我的 {earnings} 测试回本。联系他人、分享资料、购买或申请前，请先问我。

phases.title: 查清现行规定、平台保险和收入证据，并找实际在售的车款
phases.note: 陆路交通管理局规定和获批清单、平台骑手页面、保险、公积金、五款零售商品
phases.judgment: 它没有编造收入增长：找到的收入资料只有一份 2022 年研究和 2026 年 Grab 的限期新手奖励，都不能证明助力车会带来持续的增收；某平台的保险页面只看到搜索摘要，因此标为未确认。

phases.title: 写出指南，并附预算和回本计算
phases.note: 先给建议，再列规定清单、五款车型、保险对比和回本表

phases.title: 独立核对说法和计算，并检查电脑和手机上的版面
补上核对时发现的缺口：骑行规范和罚则
phases.judgment: 独立复核发现规则清单漏了骑手需要知道的内容：单列行驶、自行车道，以及在路径上发生事故后该怎么做。补充后附上陆路交通管理局公布的四个罚则示例，复核再确认每个示例都与原表一致。

phases.title: 重新核对计算、前后一致性和版面
更新独立核对结果，写明已解决和仍未解决的事项
phases.note: 仍保留的未决事项：具体车辆是否获批、保险、配件费用

workers: 查阅送餐平台自己的骑手规定和保险页面、永久居民的公积金情况，以及有日期的公开收入资料
找到五款零售商在售的助力自行车，记下带日期的价格和续航，并与陆路交通管理局官方获批清单对照
独立重算每个金额并对照来源核对指南；指出缺失的骑行规范，修改后再复核
